cinematic.wrmarvel.intro.title: ACT 1 · DOOMSDAY
line.wrmarvel.s001_001: Steve! You're back! I was beginning to think you'd found another dimension to get lost in.
line.wrmarvel.s001_002: Not this time. Just a few mountains, some caves, and more skeletons than I care to remember.
line.wrmarvel.s001_003: Sounds like another ordinary adventure for you.
line.wrmarvel.s001_005: Actually, there's something I've been meaning to show you.
line.wrmarvel.s001_007: Two maps. Same valley. Same coordinates. Surveyed at different times.
line.wrmarvel.s001_013: The earlier survey shows nothing there. No ruins. No foundations. Nothing.
line.wrmarvel.s001_014: Maybe whoever made the first map missed it.
line.wrmarvel.s001_015: I made the first map, Steve. I walked that valley myself.
line.wrmarvel.s001_016: Then how did an entire building appear out of nowhere?
line.wrmarvel.s001_017: I was hoping you might help me answer that.
line.wrmarvel.s001_018: Well, there's only one way to find out.
line.wrmarvel.s001_019: Steve, please be careful. Something about this doesn't feel right.
line.wrmarvel.s001_020: I've handled worse than an abandoned building.
line.wrmarvel.s001_022: I'll take a look. If I find anything interesting, you'll be the first to know.
line.wrmarvel.s001_023: Just make sure you come back!
line.wrmarvel.s001_025: Same valley... but that definitely wasn't there before.
line.wrmarvel.s001_026: Looks like I've got a bit of a walk ahead of me.
line.wrmarvel.s002_002: Okay... that's definitely not supposed to be here.
line.wrmarvel.s002_003: These blocks... I've never seen anything built like this.
line.wrmarvel.s002_004: Someone went through a lot of trouble to hide this place.
line.wrmarvel.s002_006: Great. Just me and a creepy underground ruin.
line.wrmarvel.s002_007: Redstone... but not like any redstone I've worked with.
line.wrmarvel.s002_008: What kind of language is this?
line.wrmarvel.s002_009: There's got to be a way to activate this.
line.wrmarvel.s002_012: That... is not a Nether portal.
line.wrmarvel.s002_014: I've really got to stop jumping into things I don't understand.
line.wrmarvel.s002_015: One look. Then I'm coming straight back.
line.wrmarvel.s002_019: No... what's happening to those worlds?
line.wrmarvel.s002_020: Countless realities. Countless lives. And events whose consequences reach farther than any one world.
line.wrmarvel.s003_008: Nobody move! Hands where I can see them!
line.wrmarvel.s003_012: What are you supposed to be? Some kind of video game character?
line.wrmarvel.s003_013: Funny. I was about to ask you the same thing.
line.wrmarvel.s003_016: Okay! Pretty sure this isn't how we ask people for their belongings!
line.wrmarvel.s003_020: Give me one second! Kind of busy!
line.wrmarvel.s003_023: Webbing. Long story. You're not from around here, are you?
line.wrmarvel.s003_025: The sword, the clothes, the whole... square thing? Yeah, a little.
line.wrmarvel.s003_026: Okay, start from the beginning. What's your name?
line.wrmarvel.s003_028: Nice to meet you, Steve. You can call me Spider-Man.
line.wrmarvel.s003_030: Well, not the one on my birth certificate.
line.wrmarvel.s003_032: A village. Lots of forests, mountains, caves. Not many... whatever those metal things on the roads are.
line.wrmarvel.s003_033: Cars? You've never seen a car?
line.wrmarvel.s003_036: I went through some kind of portal. I saw other places. Worlds, I think. Then I ended up here.
line.wrmarvel.s003_039: All right. We'll figure something out.
line.wrmarvel.s004_001: Okay, I've got something. There's still a little energy left from where you appeared.
line.wrmarvel.s004_002: Can it tell us how to get home?
line.wrmarvel.s004_003: Maybe. But I've never seen readings like these.
line.wrmarvel.s004_010: The signal. Whatever brought you here, it's almost completely gone.
line.wrmarvel.s004_012: Hey. We don't know that yet.
line.wrmarvel.s004_020: Okay, hold on. Who exactly are you guys?
line.wrmarvel.s004_021: Time Variance Authority. Do not interfere.
line.wrmarvel.s005_001: All right, everybody. Let's not make this more complicated than it needs to be.
line.wrmarvel.s005_003: Mobius. I work with the TVA.
line.wrmarvel.s005_005: Yeah, I get that a lot.
line.wrmarvel.s005_006: We just need to ask you a few questions about how you got here.
line.wrmarvel.s005_007: I'd love to know that myself.
line.wrmarvel.s005_009: Welcome to the Time Variance Authority.
line.wrmarvel.s005_011: Let's just say it's a little more complicated.
line.wrmarvel.s005_014: Okay, Steve. Where do you come from?
line.wrmarvel.s005_015: My world. A village near the mountains.
line.wrmarvel.s005_016: Right. And do you know which universe that is?
line.wrmarvel.s005_027: It means we can't find your home universe in our records.
line.wrmarvel.s005_028: Wait. You mean my home is gone?
line.wrmarvel.s005_029: No. That's not what I'm saying. We just don't know where it is.
line.wrmarvel.s005_030: Then I need to find it.
line.wrmarvel.s005_031: And I think we need to understand how you got here in the first place.
line.wrmarvel.s005_032: Yesterday, I was looking at a map. Now I'm being told nobody knows where my universe is.
line.wrmarvel.s005_033: Well, Steve... you certainly know how to make an entrance.
line.wrmarvel.s005_034: Believe me. I wasn't trying to.
line.wrmarvel.s005_035: Keep the file open. I want a full review of that arrival signature.
panel.wrmarvel.survey.new: Latest survey. Same valley, same coordinates.
message.wrmarvel.climb_to_roof: Spider-Man is waiting on the shop roof. Climb the ladder by the door.
message.wrmarvel.surveys_given: The cartographer hands you both surveys. Use one to unroll it.
message.wrmarvel.use_terminal: Use the terminal to run the origin analysis.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d006_mobius_001: I checked the coordinates again. Still no match.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d006_steve_001: So you don't know where it is.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d006_mobius_002: That's different from knowing it's gone.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d006_mobius_003: Tell me about home. Before the ruins.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d006_steve_002: The Overworld. The Nether. The End. I thought that was everything.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d006_mobius_004: Connected dimensions. What you reached in New York was another universe.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d006_mobius_005: Not necessarily. Different place, different history. We haven't established that you travelled through time.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d006_steve_004: There were worlds around me. More than I could count.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d006_steve_005: Some of them were breaking apart.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d006_steve_006: There was someone in the passage. He was watching me.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d006_steve_007: I saw different worlds. Earths overlapping. Lines of light breaking.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d006_mobius_006: Let's compare that with your arrival.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d006_steve_009: I saw him in the passage.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d006_mobius_009: Different places. Same figure. No identity we can verify.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d006_ops_officer_001: Incursion response. Extraction teams require immediate gateway support.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d006_field_agent_001: We have another group approaching. Hold the exit.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d006_ops_officer_002: Your doorway is holding. Keep moving.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d006_steve_013: Those places I saw… there were people there.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d007_steve_001: Can you get anyone else out?
line.wrmarvel.wr_d007_mobius_001: The teams are checking every route that still answers.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d007_mobius_002: Help us keep this area moving. People coming through need somewhere to go.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d007_reception_worker_0: The walkway's blocked. Supplies are behind that trolley. And we've got people separated between reception points.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d007_survivor_001: They came through before me. I couldn't see where they went.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d007_steve_005: Stay together. The reception team will help you from here.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d007_steve_007: I don't know. Let's get you somewhere safe first.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d007_steve_008: They're still checking the routes. I won't promise something I can't know.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d007_steve_009: Did anyone tell Spider-Man where I went?
line.wrmarvel.wr_d007_mobius_003: Your request is still pending. The gateway teams are handling the extractions.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d007_security_agent_001: That door isn't scheduled. Everyone back.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d008_security_agent_001: Identify yourselves. Stop where you are.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d008_mobius_001: Steve! Get them away from the doors. Emergency route, now.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d008_steve_002: One at a time. Keep moving.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d008_evac_worker_001: I've got them. Give us a moment.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d008_agent_001: We've still got people behind the reception doors.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d008_mobius_002: Take this group ahead. Follow the emergency signs.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d008_mobius_003: I'm going back for the others.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d009_coordinator_001: This route is still open. Bring them through.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d009_steve_002: Keep going. I'm right behind you.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d010_uatu_001: How did you enter this place?
line.wrmarvel.wr_d010_steve_001: A doorway. The building was coming down.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d010_steve_003: I wasn't trying to come here.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d010_uatu_004: He sought an escape. I will take responsibility for his presence.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d010_other_watcher_002: Then he observes. He does not interfere.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d010_steve_004: The people I sent through. Did they make it?
line.wrmarvel.wr_d010_uatu_006: We have not established what became of him.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d010_uatu_007: You may remain here while we consider your situation.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d010_uatu_008: You may observe and speak with me. You may not enter those realities or send messages into them while accepting this sanctuary.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d010_steve_010: I need somewhere to start. I'll stay.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d010_steve_011: I'll respect your conditions. But I still want answers.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d010_steve_012: Can you show me New York? Spider-Man.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d010_steve_013: He's looking for me. Just let me tell him I'm alive.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d010_uatu_010: I know what I'm asking of you. But that is their condition.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d011_spiderman_004: Something else opened here after I left.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d011_spiderman_005: Stay still. I've got the car.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d011_spiderman_007: Get back from the road. Give the emergency crews space.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d011_spiderman_008: Please tell me that's a projection.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d011_daredevil_002: We're comparing reports. Hell's Kitchen. I'll send the location.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d011_spiderman_011: A man came through a portal. Called himself Steve. He helped me stop a robbery.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d011_spiderman_012: He's missing. Something else happened where he arrived.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d011_daredevil_004: Then we don't build the explanation around that.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d011_luke_001: People downstairs are watching another planet in the sky. We need somewhere safe to direct them if this gets worse.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d011_danny_001: I'll check whether anyone recognises the phenomenon. I'm not calling it magic without evidence.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d011_jessica_002: I'll compare the sightings. See whether everyone's recording the same thing.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d011_frank_002: I'll watch for anyone using the panic.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d011_daredevil_005: And we share what we can verify.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d011_spiderman_014: If you find Steve, contact me.

line.wrmarvel.wr_d012_shuri_001: Send the original recordings. Not copies from broadcasts.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d012_scott_001: Please say somebody’s already ruled out a very ambitious advertising campaign.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d012_sam_002: Joaquin, we get above the interference. Scott, Shang-Chi—help the crews below.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d012_shuri_003: Received. Keep your instruments on the same settings.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d012_sam_004: We’re not getting closer just for a better picture.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d012_pilot_001: We’re losing reliable instruments. Requesting assistance.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d012_joaquin_002: Captain, helicopter west of us. They’re struggling to hold position.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d012_sam_005: I see them. Shuri, save the survey. We’re switching to rescue.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d012_sam_006: Look at me. Follow my instructions.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d012_sam_007: Right now, we’re getting you down.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d012_shuri_004: Your flight recordings are clean enough to isolate the surface.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d012_shuri_005: This is not just a light in the atmosphere. There are surface features—and artificial lights.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d012_sam_010: Then protecting our world doesn’t mean treating theirs as an enemy.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d013_yelena_001: Scientists inside. Emergency power failing. That is the mission.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d013_bucky_001: People first. Records if we can reach them safely.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d013_kate_001: We’ve got people across the broken section.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d013_clint_001: They called us before the comms went down.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d013_yelena_002: Of course you were already here.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d013_bucky_002: This way. Stay with the person ahead of you.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d013_clint_003: One at a time. Keep your weight centred.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d013_sentry_002: I can hold this. Keep them moving.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d013_scientist_001: It was measuring the disturbance before the building failed.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d013_scientist_002: The recorder. Not the whole array.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d013_scientist_003: The boundary disturbance keeps returning. Each appearance lasts longer.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d013_scientist_004: Enough that the old projections are no longer reliable.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d013_bucky_005: We have independent readings. We should compare them.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d013_sam_001: Send what you have. We’ll make one picture.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d014_sam_001: We’ve been answering the same emergency from different directions. That changes now.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d014_yelena_001: Good. Start with the part we can act on.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d014_bucky_001: The facility recorder is independent of the flight survey.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d014_shuri_001: And both show the same trend.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d014_shuri_002: The appearances are lasting longer. The intervals are shortening.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d014_sam_003: We need contact before assumptions become orders.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d014_sam_004: Share the evidence. Nobody works from half a picture.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d014_clint_001: What do we tell the crews?
line.wrmarvel.wr_d014_sam_005: What we know. And what we don’t.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d014_shuri_003: There may be a window. We can attempt a transmission.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d014_reed_001: We can see your Earth. We’re trying to stop this too.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d014_sam_006: This is Captain America. Who am I speaking to?
line.wrmarvel.wr_d014_sam_007: We have people studying the disturbance here.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d014_shuri_005: I can send a limited packet of readings.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d014_reed_003: Send it. I’ll return our measurements.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d014_reed_004: We are measuring the same boundary from opposite sides.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d014_sam_008: Then our objective is to save both worlds.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d014_reed_006: I’ll work on keeping this channel open.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d015_johnny_001: So there really are people over there.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d015_ben_001: There are people here too. Tell me where you need me.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d015_reed_001: The receiving system is losing alignment.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d015_sue_001: Then we keep it steady. Johnny, rooftop sensors. Ben, the support assembly.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d015_johnny_002: First sensor’s mounted. Second position is moving.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d015_ben_002: This thing is trying to leave the room.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d015_reed_003: Hold the base. Not the upper ring.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d015_sue_005: The same thing your people are dealing with. We’ve got the channel back.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d015_reed_006: Yes. The pattern repeats beyond our two universes.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d015_reed_007: We don’t have a complete count.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d015_reed_008: Saving our two worlds won’t be enough.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d016_beast_001: The station stopped transmitting during the last disturbance.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d016_xavier_001: Find them. Bring back the readings if it is safe.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d016_magneto_001: And find out how close this is coming.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d016_cyclops_002: Jean, Hank, Kurt. We go together.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d016_cyclops_003: Kurt, locate the staff. Jean, keep the route protected. Hank, stay with me.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d016_jean_002: That beam is carrying the ceiling.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d016_nightcrawler_002: I can bring them to the cleared position.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d016_cyclops_005: One group at a time. We’ll hold the route.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d016_scientist_001: The lower recorder is still running.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d016_beast_004: The backup has the last complete survey.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d016_cyclops_006: Take the recorder. We are not rebuilding the station.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d016_beast_005: No. The coordinates are consistent. The terrain is not.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d016_beast_006: That is what the evidence suggests.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d016_cyclops_008: Send the coordinates to the Professor.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d016_xavier_002: Begin preparations to move the students if necessary.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d016_cyclops_009: Then help us protect them. We investigate the site before anything crosses.
line.wrmarvel.wr_d016_magneto_003: And if investigation is not enough?
line.wrmarvel.wr_d016_cyclops_010: We decide from evidence. Not fear.
quest.wrmarvel.wr1_012.summary: The Avengers survey the phenomenon. Shuri confirms the other Earth is inhabited.
quest.wrmarvel.wr1_012.s12_response_star: Get the briefing, review the route and launch
quest.wrmarvel.wr1_012.s12_passengers_sa: Get the passengers down to the crews
quest.wrmarvel.wr1_012.s12_complete: Land with them and hear Shuri's results
quest.wrmarvel.wr1_013.summary: The New Avengers, Clint and Kate evacuate a damaged research facility.
quest.wrmarvel.wr1_013.s13_first_group_s: Reach the first trapped group and bring them out
quest.wrmarvel.wr1_013.s13_staff_evacuat: Get the rest of the staff across and out
quest.wrmarvel.wr1_014.summary: The responders come together and reach Reed Richards in another universe.
quest.wrmarvel.wr1_015.summary: The Fantastic Four keep the channel open and find more than two universes affected.
quest.wrmarvel.wr1_015.s15_lab_secured: Shield the staff and Reed's console
quest.wrmarvel.wr1_015.s15_sensors_onlin: Give Johnny a platform for the second sensor
quest.wrmarvel.wr1_015.s15_assembly_stab: Protect the connection while Ben holds the assembly
quest.wrmarvel.wr1_016.summary: The X-Men rescue a monitoring station's staff and find an overlap near the school.
quest.wrmarvel.wr1_016.s16_access_opened: Open a safe way into the station
quest.wrmarvel.wr1_016.s16_staff_safe: Get every member of staff out
ability.wrmarvel.sam_flight.desc: Launch, or drop out of flight. Space climbs, Shift descends.
ability.wrmarvel.bucky_lift.desc: Move the heavy debris you are looking at with the metal arm.
ability.wrmarvel.sue_field.desc: Project a field where you are looking (up to 16 blocks). Three at a time; a fourth replaces the oldest.
ability.wrmarvel.sue_release.desc: Let go of every field you are holding.
ability.wrmarvel.optic_blast.desc: A controlled blast where you are looking. Check the target read-out before you fire.
cinematic.wrmarvel.s12_title.where: New York, MU-616 · Avengers response base
cinematic.wrmarvel.s13_title.where: New York, MU-616 · A damaged research facility
cinematic.wrmarvel.s14_title.where: New York, MU-616 · Joint emergency briefing
panel.wrmarvel.r.route.title: FLIGHT ROUTE
panel.wrmarvel.r.route.joaquin: Joaquin flies a complementary route · same instrument settings
panel.wrmarvel.r.plan.title: JOINT PLAN
panel.wrmarvel.r.plan.no_assumptions: Do not assume the other Earth is attacking
panel.wrmarvel.r.contact.title: CHANNEL
toast.wrmarvel.r.findings.title: Findings circulated
toast.wrmarvel.r.channel.title: The transmission is stabilised.
toast.wrmarvel.milestone3.title: Scenes 12–16 complete
toast.wrmarvel.milestone3.detail: To be continued · free travel restored
message.wrmarvel.r.review_route: Review the marked flight route at the table.
message.wrmarvel.r.launch: Go to the launch pad outside and launch: [Z] Wings.
message.wrmarvel.r.fly: [Z] launch or drop · Space climb · Shift descend. Hold steady inside each marker.
message.wrmarvel.r.ceiling: Holding altitude. We're surveying, not climbing towards it.
message.wrmarvel.r.hold_steady: Position %s/%s · hold steady inside the marker (%s%%)
message.wrmarvel.r.switch_to_rescue: The helicopter is west of you. Match its speed and come in at the side door.
message.wrmarvel.r.rotor: Rotor! Come in from the side, not over the top.
message.wrmarvel.r.approach_ok: Approach established. Take them one at a time.
message.wrmarvel.r.match_speed: Too fast. Match the helicopter's speed.
message.wrmarvel.r.approach_hint: Hold position at the side door, matching its speed, then reach for a passenger.
message.wrmarvel.r.carrying: Got them. Take them down to the crews.
message.wrmarvel.r.follow_cable: Follow Clint and Kate's cable route to the trapped group.
message.wrmarvel.r.lift_hint: [Z] Heavy Lift while looking at the obstruction (or use it).
message.wrmarvel.r.brace_hint: The door is unstable. Brace it before anyone goes through.
message.wrmarvel.r.lead_group: Lead them out. They follow in a line.
message.wrmarvel.r.cover_yelena: Cover Yelena: stay close while she checks the rooms.
message.wrmarvel.r.take_them_out: Take them out to the responders.
message.wrmarvel.r.seal_open: Ghost has opened the sealed section from the inside.
message.wrmarvel.r.clear_exit: Rubble across the exit. Help Walker clear it: [Z] Heavy Lift.
message.wrmarvel.r.one_at_a_time: One at a time. Keep off the cable while someone is on it.
message.wrmarvel.r.recorder_route: The recorder is past the crossing. Take the cable route; the scientist stays here.
message.wrmarvel.r.unsafe_route: That edge is failing. Use the cable crossing.
message.wrmarvel.r.recorder_taken: Recorder removed. Not the whole array.
message.wrmarvel.r.array_hint: At the array outside: route power, align the receiver, test the channel.
message.wrmarvel.r.not_aligned: Receiver not aligned. Check the signal strength.
message.wrmarvel.r.send_packet: Send Shuri's readings from the transmitter.
message.wrmarvel.r.received: Received. Their measurements are coming back.
message.wrmarvel.r.field_hint: [Z] field where you look · [X] release · three fields at most. Cover the aisle ahead of the staff and Reed's console.
message.wrmarvel.r.cover_aisle: They won't cross without a field over the next stretch.
message.wrmarvel.r.console_hit: The console took a hit. Reed loses ground.
message.wrmarvel.r.staff_back: They fall back to the last covered point.
message.wrmarvel.r.roof_hint: Up the ladder in the corner to the roof.
message.wrmarvel.r.platform_gone: Johnny needs that platform until he's done.
message.wrmarvel.r.guard_hint: Field walls beside the connection stop loose debris. Watch where it sparks.
message.wrmarvel.r.field_blocked: No room for a field there.
message.wrmarvel.r.not_the_incursion: The transmission is stabilised. The incursion is not.
message.wrmarvel.r.blast_hint: The side door is blocked. [Z] Optic Blast at the damaged debris only.
message.wrmarvel.r.unstable_entrance: The upper section is giving way. Find another way in.
message.wrmarvel.r.aim.debris: Target: damaged debris · clear to fire
message.wrmarvel.r.aim.person: Someone in the line of fire · hold
message.wrmarvel.r.setback: The prop splinters and part of the corridor comes down again. Jean holds the ceiling.
message.wrmarvel.r.clear_spot: Clear the arrival spot so Kurt can bring them down.
message.wrmarvel.r.corridor_blocked: Debris across the corridor ahead of them. Clear it.
message.wrmarvel.r.rec.clamps_off: Clamps released. Next: the recorder unit.
